item.title: About Me
item.description:
Shuyuan LI — Founder, Lens Strategy

I’ve spent my career on nearly every side of the CRM table — as the analyst reading the data, the strategist designing the system, and the operator running it day to day. That includes both sides of modern CRM: campaign-driven marketing (email, SMS, and other channels reaching clients at scale) and clienteling, the 1-to-1 relationship between a brand and its highest-value clients. Lens Strategy exists to bring that full-circle view to brands that want their CRM to actually drive growth, at every level from mass personalization to the individual client.

item.title: Contact
item.description:
Get in Touch

Whether you have a CRM challenge you’d like a second opinion on, a question about a case study, or just want to connect — I’d be glad to hear from you.

Connect on LinkedIn →

item.title: Prose
item.description:
Lens Strategy

CRM is often treated as a technical function — a stack of tools, a list of automations. Lens Strategy starts from a different premise: CRM is a lens. It’s how a brand chooses to see its clients, and in luxury and beauty especially, that choice shows up in every touchpoint — from a single personalized email to the way a client is remembered when they walk into a boutique.

item.title: Services
item.description:
How I Can Help

CRM Strategy & Roadmap Design

End-to-end CRM strategy built from the ground up — segmentation, database architecture, and campaign planning designed as one connected system, not disjointed pieces.

Clienteling Program Design & Setup

Structured programs for 1-to-1 client engagement — from VIC tracking and retail team training to the processes that make personalization feel consistent, not accidental.
